resolution.description: Delivery tier. `2k` is 2016 px on the long edge for 16:9 and 9:16, and the 1440p row for 1:1, 4:3 and 3:4.

duration.description: Length of the generated video in seconds at 24 FPS, rounded by the model to the nearest legal frame count (5 s -> 121 frames, 10 s -> 241, 15 s -> 361). With `audio_url`, the first `duration` seconds of the audio are used; shorter audio is padded with silence.

prompt.description: Direction for the visuals, spoken dialogue, sounds, and on-screen text. Structure it with `[VISUAL]`, `[SPEECH]`, `[SOUNDS]`, and `[TEXT]` sections for best results. English is the validated language.
examples:
[VISUAL]
A cinematic product close-up of a sparkling-water can on wet black stone.
Condensation rolls down the can as the camera makes a slow half-orbit.

[SPEECH]
"Clean flavor. Bright finish. Nothing extra."

[SOUNDS]
A crisp can opening, gentle fizz, and restrained electronic music.

[TEXT]
None.

image_url.description: Optional reference image to animate. Guides identity, composition, and appearance; the output follows this image's aspect ratio.

audio_url.description: Optional driving audio (narration, dialogue, or a soundtrack). When provided it is preserved in the output instead of generated speech.

manifest_disclosure.description: Add a visible `AI-generated` disclosure label to the video. Invisible C2PA metadata and watermarking are always applied.

negative_prompt.description: Content or artifacts to avoid in the generated video.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame ratio. `auto` follows the reference image's own ratio, and is landscape (16:9) when there is no image. A named ratio renders that ratio; with an image it centre-crops the image to it.
